decks.notes: This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing a mix of removal, counter spells, and card advantage to control the game and out-value the opponent. With a variety of versatile answers such as Solitude, Archmage's Charm, and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The inclusion of March of Otherworldly Light and Shark Typhoon provides additional win conditions and a way to close out the game once the opponent's threats have been neutralized.

The deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with cycling creatures and then cascade into Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo play. The focus is on manipulating the graveyard and using cascade effects to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden swarm of creatures. The deck utilizes a mix of cycling creatures, cascade spells, and disruption to set up the perfect Living End play and take control of the game.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around playing aggressively with high-risk, high-reward cards like Death's Shadow and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes the graveyard as a resource with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Drown in the Loch. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to quickly deplete the opponent's life total while maintaining control of the board.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Colossus Hammer combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip the hammer for a massive amount of damage. The deck also includes Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel for protection and disruption, as well as Urza's Saga for additional artifact synergy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with an early, explosive combo while maintaining control over the game with counterspells and protection spells. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing a diverse range of colors to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. By combining powerful multicolor spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Helix with creatures like Geist of Saint Traft and Scion of Draco, the deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent. The deck also benefits from mana ramp with cards like Ignoble Hierarch and General Ferrous Rokiric, allowing for explosive plays and quick victories. With a mix of removal, burn spells, and aggressive creatures, this deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and power.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for creative and unexpected combos to be pulled off quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify, the player can quickly get powerful creatures onto the battlefield, such as Archon of Cruelty. Leyline Binding helps control the opponent's resources, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides card advantage. The deck also includes versatile spells like Prismari Command and Lightning Bolt for removal and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and provide flexibility in casting spells.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat out equipment like Colossus Hammer or the Kaldra Compleat. By equipping these powerful artifacts to creatures like Gingerbrute or Inkmoth Nexus, the deck aims to deal massive damage and win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel to disrupt opponents' plans and Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, explosive plays to overwhelm opponents.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful, efficient creatures and disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. By combining aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer with disruptive cards such as Thoughtseize and Terminate, the deck aims to control the battlefield and push for quick victories. The inclusion of cards like Grief and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds another layer of disruption and allows the deck to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. The deck also features some graveyard recursion and removal options to maintain tempo and advantage throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using a mix of powerful control spells, card advantage engines, and versatile threats to outvalue and outlast the opponent. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and generate card advantage, along with powerful interaction like Counterspell and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to grind out the opponent while setting up for a game-ending play with Yorion, Sky Nomad and Emrakul, the Promised End. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's four-colored requirements and maximize consistency.

This deck focuses on using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck utilizes Leyline Binding to protect its combo pieces and interacts with the opponent's strategy using cards like Prismari Command, Lightning Bolt, and Spell Pierce. The mana base is built around fetching lands efficiently with cards like Wrenn and Six and utilizing a mix of shock and fetch lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing cycling creatures to fill up the graveyard quickly, then casting cards like Violent Outburst to bring all creatures back from the graveyard onto the battlefield with Living End. By cycling through your deck efficiently and controlling the board with disruptive creatures like Grief and Subtlety, you can overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence and lack of resources. The deck also includes ways to counter opponent's spells with Force of Negation and generate card advantage with cards like Shardless Agent. The key strategy is to set up a game-winning Living End combo.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards while disrupting the opponent, eventually casting Living End to bring back all the graveyard creatures and put them onto the battlefield. With a mixture of creatures that cycle for low mana costs and cards like Grief and Shardless Agent to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game through fast and efficient combo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board using removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fire / Ice while ramping up mana with Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The ultimate goal is to use Scapeshift to sacrifice lands and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, dealing massive damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes Wrenn and Six for card advantage and land recursion, as well as Expressive Iteration for card selection. Overall, the deck's strategy is to control the game until it can assemble its combo and win in one explosive turn.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through cards like Sakura-Tribe Elder and Search for Tomorrow, while using Primeval Titan to search for lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Once Valakut is online and enough mountains are in play, the combo of Scapeshift and Valakut can deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent for a quick win. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn and Six for extra value and consistency, making it a powerful combo deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Sakura-Tribe Elder, while exploiting the combo potential of Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor to generate huge amounts of value and mana. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to execute its game-winning strategy of fetching powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Castle Garenbrig. The key goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful land triggers in the mid to late game.

This deck focuses on quickly generating multiple tokens on the battlefield through the mechanic of Cascade, utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cast powerful spells for free. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and disruption spells, while also having control elements like Force of Negation and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the board state. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in generating card advantage and controlling the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade spells to put high-impact cards onto the battlefield for free, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The goal is to quickly generate a board presence through cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Ardent Plea, while also using cards like Solitude and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a versatile companion option, providing additional value and options for the deck. With a versatile mix of spells and creatures, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupting their game plan. The goal is to continually generate value by cascading into free spells while keeping the opponent off balance with counterspells and bounce effects. Additionally, it aims to control the board with Leyline Binding and tempo plays from Brazen Borrower and Teferi, Time Raveler. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by blinking permanents for more Cascade triggers and overall advantage. The deck's mana base is designed to support the wide range of colors needed for its spells.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker early in the game. The deck also utilizes Prismari Command and Wrenn and Six for additional value and card advantage. Leyline Binding and Shadow Prophecy help control the board while Lightning Bolt provides additional removal. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately winning through overwhelming creature presence and synergy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency.

This deck aims to assemble a combination of creatures that work together to create powerful synergies and generate value. The key concept revolves around utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Chord of Calling, and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for and play specific creatures at the right time. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures, such as Geralf's Messenger, Endurance, Blood Artist, and Strangleroot Geist, to provide different types of utility and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Boseiju, Who Endures to enhance its effectiveness.

The main idea of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures early in the game and disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. With cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Lightning Skelemental, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Dauthi Voidwalker helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan and gain an advantage in the match.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the opponent's board while using cards like Undying Evil and Malakir Rebirth to protect its own creatures. With cards like Blood Moon and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and emerge victorious in the 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and removal spells such as Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration allows for card selection and advantage, while Teferi, Time Raveler can help control the pace of the game. The mana base is set up to support the deck's aggressive plays and provide access to all necessary colors.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while controlling the game with versatile spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence and drawing into more threats with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base is optimized to support a fast and consistent game plan, with a mix of lands that can produce both red and blue mana efficiently.
